market_context: The Nasdaq-100 rose 2.61% to 26,726.39 (QQQ +2.69% to $650.99) in a half-day Black Friday session as investors bought beaten-down AI and semiconductor shares; the PHLX Semiconductor Index jumped 4.69%, the Nasdaq Composite gained 2.31% to 24,129.50, the S&P 500 1.60% to 7,297.49 and the Dow 1.18% to 50,774.94.
market_cap_basis: Shares outstanding x 2026-11-27 close. Shares implied from Nasdaq market caps as of the 2026-10-29 close (watchlist market_cap_usd / 2026-10-29 close), so multi-class companies (e.g. GOOGL) reflect all share classes.

stocks.name: Palantir Technologies Inc. Class A Common Stock
stocks.reason: Poland's defence ministry signed a five-year, roughly $300 million contract on Friday for Palantir's Maven Smart System, an AI tool to help military commanders make decisions. Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz said all keys, servers and information will remain the exclusive property of the Polish Armed Forces.

stocks.name: Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated Common Stock
stocks.reason: Vertex fell on the first trading session after it said the FDA had extended the review of povetacicept, its experimental IgA nephropathy drug, pushing the decision deadline to no later than February 28, 2027 from November 30. The agency treated an information request as a major amendment; Citi's Geoffrey Meacham said the stock faced near-term pressure as expectations reset but did not see the delay as thesis-changing.

sources.title: Vertex Announces Extension of PDUFA Target Action Date by up to Three Months as FDA Completes Review of the Biologics License Application for Povetacicept in IgA Nephropathy
Vertex Pharma falls after FDA extends review of kidney disease drug

stocks.name: Tesla Inc. Common Stock
stocks.reason: Tesla climbed after Germany's Federal Cartel Office published its antitrust filing to acquire EMAG, a German maker of precision machining systems used for humanoid-robot gears. A European Commission draft agenda also indicated EU countries may vote on December 15 on approving Tesla's assisted-driving system.
